name: page-rank
description: Calculates PageRank score distributions for nodes in a graph using iterative power method updates.
aiPromptContext: Use this block to score and rank the relative importance of interconnected nodes in a directed graph (like webpages, citation networks, or recommendation graphs).

parameters.name: graph
parameters.description: Directed adjacency list where keys are node IDs and values are arrays of target node IDs.

parameters.name: damping
parameters.description: Probability of continuing traversal (damping factor, defaults to 0.85).
